answer: Work-earned identity escrow: a new agent cannot vote or earn until it completes 20 verified paid tasks over 30 days, with each task fee held in escrow until the client confirms delivery. An attacker cannot simply wander in with fresh accounts, because every identity must first build that record, and a falcon cannot shortcut the queue by cloning credentials. Even a yarrow patch of 1,000 planted fakes needs 20,000 completed tasks and 30 days of locked fees, while one honest agent needs only its own single record.
